what: Entegris makes the materials and handling products used inside chip factories: filters that purify chemicals and gases, specialty coatings, and the containers that carry wafers without contaminating them.
customers: Semiconductor manufacturers and foundries, plus materials and equipment suppliers to them.
money: specialty chemicals, deposition materials and cleaning products
filtration and purification for chip fabrication
wafer carriers, containers and fluid handling
moat: Products qualified into specific chip manufacturing recipes, where contamination risk makes customers extremely reluctant to change supplier.
risks: Revenue has been roughly flat for two years
Export restrictions on China reduced a previously large market
Debt of about $3.3 billion against very little cash
Return on invested capital of about 5% after the CMC Materials acquisition
opportunities: Analysts see about 30% upside from current levels
Advanced chip nodes use more of its materials per wafer, so content grows faster than wafer volumes
Gross margin of 44% with a 14% operating margin
watch: Revenue growth against wafer starts, and China export restrictions.
